name: workflow-mods
description: Small Claude Code mods for shipping, deploy verification, session status, usage limits and prompt-cache management.

plugins.name: mod-installer
plugins.description: Start here: type /mods to preview the workflow mods, tick the ones you want and install them.

plugins.name: all-mods
plugins.description: Everything in one install, no choices. Install this OR the individual mods, never both.

plugins.name: status-strip
plugins.description: One quiet strip: repo, docs, deploy, context and cache, each with a button

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Clickable options for what to do next, so you click instead of type

plugins.name: ship-it
plugins.description: A bare "deploy it" becomes the full ship checklist

plugins.name: usage-guard
plugins.description: Rate-limit usage in the bottom bar; guards agent fan-out
